title: papyrus odorata
intro: Papyrus odorata, commonly known as Vetiver grass, is a tropical, perennial plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and alleviate symptoms of insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Vetiver grass are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include vetiverol, vetiverone, and beta-vetivone, that have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and sedative properties. The plant's essential oil has also been used in aromatherapy to promote relaxation, reduce pain, and improve mood.
